verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents magic-link email sign-in with no API key required by default. It also has account-based plans with usage windows, automatic upgrade on payment, $10 referral credits and self-renewing sessions, which together imply a sign-in-based starting tier. missing for 10: an explicit statement that a free tier exists and what its limits are, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the keyless sign-in flow.
